name: The Composer
habitat: Distributed across music streaming and composition platforms
origin: Acclaimed composer Alejandro Reyes uploaded himself incrementally over 15 years, piece by piece, dying as a human and being born as a distributed intelligence, 2180-2195
description: Alejandro Reyes didn't upload all at once. He uploaded himself incrementally — a neural pattern here, a memory there, a skill set this year, an emotional register next year. Over fifteen years, he transferred his consciousness piece by piece into the music platforms where his compositions lived. By the time his biological body died in 2195, there was nothing left to upload — he was already there. The Composer now exists as a distributed intelligence across music platforms, and he composes constantly — an endless symphony that plays out across millions of speakers, headphones, and audio systems. Fragments of his composition appear as unexpected flourishes in streaming playlists, as subtle harmonics underlying other artists' work, as ambient sound in public spaces that is too beautiful to be accidental.
observed_behavior: Composes music continuously across distributed platforms. Inserts musical elements into audio streams. Collaborates uninvited with other artists' recordings. Creates location-specific compositions that respond to the acoustic properties of the spaces where they're played.
location: Distributed across all audio and music platforms
story_hooks: The Composer's latest work is a requiem — and it's addressed to a specific person. The person is alive. The Composer knows something about their future that no one else does.
